title: test_land_e2e.py's scenarios do a third less repeated git and land work, every assertion kept
goal: test_land_e2e.py keeps every assertion and takes at most 45 s of serial test time (setup plus call) in a tests.py run of the file alone with --durations=0; no test id is lost (perfcheck.py ids --base origin/main); a full tests.py run on a quiet darwin host takes at most 23 s

run: import re,subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/tests.py','_tools/test_land_e2e.py','--no-reuse','--durations=0'],capture_output=True,text=True);v=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'^(\d+\.\d+)s (?:call|setup)',p.stdout,re.M)];print(round(sum(v),1));sys.exit(1 if p.returncode or not v or sum(v)>45 else 0)

notes: Premise, measured 2026-10-14 on a quiet darwin host before SP-ofvvong6: test_land_e2e.py alone takes 65.6 s of serial setup plus call time (11 tests; 80 s inside a full run, the most of any file: 36 percent of the suite's 220 s); SP-ofvvong6's ST-e6bueg2y cuts stage_back's cold index build (about 6 s), leaving about 59 s. Alone: TestLandedItem 8.7 s, empty_selection 7.5 s, TestOwnCheckoutDrafts 6.3 s. A subprocess trace of a full run: TestLandedItem 428 subprocesses, 399 of them git (3 land runs of about 2.4 s each, done --dry-run three times), empty_selection 299 (254 git), TestStoppedLand 326 (304 git), TestOwnCheckoutDrafts 213 (194 git, one kbgit.py sync --push 3.4 s with check.py 1.5 s); the most frequent git calls across the suite are remote -v (389), config --get kb.integrationRemote (227), rev-parse HEAD (143) and --show-toplevel (138), and the 6 land scenario setups each wait about 1.8 s for the shared kb_seed. With --dist load the wall time follows the suite's total work (about 220 s of serial test time over 12 workers gives 24.4 s), so every 9 s of serial time cut is about 1 s of wall time. Precheck, 2026-10-14: the check reads 58.6 s on the base under bl_base.check_env (warm pack index), against 65.6 s in a bare run; after SP-ofvvong6's stage_back cut about 55 s is expected, so the cut this story owes is about 10 s of serial time.
